outcome.technical:
tools/release.py, the only file changed. (1) step_verify_release: on a pass it now asks release_verdict(ctx.repo), the same reader verify.sh's open-bug row runs through `release.py permitted`, and puts that sentence in the note: 'tools/verify.sh --release is green; <verdict>'. If the verdict now refuses (the slot expired or a bug was filed after verify.sh asked), the step fails with the refusal. (2) step_preflight, the same class of problem: its note used to say 'no open bug, no held phase' even when an armed slot released over an open bug. It now uses release_verdict and its note is '<verdict>; tag vX is free'. release_permitted and the module docstring were reworded to match; release_permitted keeps its (allowed, refusal-or-None) contract. (3) rl16 and rl21 read and wrote files without closing them: rl16 had `io.open(...).read()` in a dict comprehension, and rl21's lambda had `io.open(...).write()`. Both now go through new selftest helpers _read_text and _write_text, each using `with`. (4) rl21b's comment cited gr18 as proof that the guard releases over an unread plan when a slot is armed. It now says gr72e pins that pairing and gr18 asserts only the refusal with no slot. New cases: rl24, rl24b, rl24c, rl24d, rl25. Gate `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tools/release.py`, run without a pipe: exit 0, `1/1 files ok, 70 cases`. Also ruff check tools/release.py exit 0 and vermin -t=3.8- exit 0. _output_lints.prose_number_claims() reports no hit in release.py. Sweep over the dependants (tests/test__refs.py, tests/test_stamp_verification.py, tools/affected.py, tools/check-example-pins.py, .claude/hooks/guard-release.py): exit 0, 5/5 files ok.
